newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Normandy extends North Flinders bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Normandy extends North Flinders bid.

text.p: Normandy Mining Ltd said on Monday it would extend its takeover offer for North Flinders Mines Ltd by one month to October 4.
Normandy's offer is 425 Normandy shares for every 100 North Flinders shares.
As of September 9, Normandy said it held 16.1 million North Flinders shares or about 70.7 percent of the company.
The takeover for North Flinders was part of a rationalisation of the Normandy Mining group which sees Gold Mines of Kalgoorlie, Posgold Ltd merge with Normandy.
North Flinders shares closed five cents higher at A$8.15 on turnover of 10,740 shares.
